answer.justification: Cirrhotic patient with 2 cm nodule; multiphasic CT shows arterial enhancement but lacks portal venous/delayed washout, so imaging is not diagnostic for HCC. Without classic washout (or capsule), cannot proceed to resection/ablation. Tissue diagnosis via liver biopsy is required to establish HCC vs other lesion before treatment. Observe too conservative for 2 cm indeterminate nodule in cirrhosis.
